Rise of the Living Garden · A Realm Philadelphia Story

THE GREAT
FOOD FIGHT

HEALTHY FOOD FIGHTS BACK. Join Farmer Iszzy Brown, the Fruit Force and the Veggie Force against the Sugar Mafia and Process Chaos. Rescue baby spuds, defend the garden, fight the food war—and help build a better Philadelphia.

PLAY THE WINDOWS DEMO ↗EXPLORE OPEN CITY ↓PARTNER WITH THE GAME ↓
2024 · From book and stage to game concept2025 · Windows demo releasedCooperative online expansion · Planned

The downloadable Windows demo is an early action prototype, not the finished, age-rated family game. Parents should review it before children play.

THE REASON THE GAME EXISTS

KNOWLEDGE IS WEALTH.
PASS IT ON.

Before Farmer Iszzy Brown commands armies of living fruits and vegetables, he inherits something more valuable than a weapon: knowledge passed between generations. An island recipe, a father’s wisdom, a child’s imagination and the Living Garden become the foundation of a world worth protecting.

Gather the vegetables. Find the crew. Master the brew. Make the stew. Stop the flu.

FROM BOOK TO BATTLEFIELD

February 1, 2024: The Melodies of a Farmer was published. April 15, 2024: the creator and his son performed the book’s music on stage. By year’s end the world had evolved into a video game. In 2025 the Windows proof of concept was released alongside the founder’s reported Philadelphia Gaming Task Force involvement.

The creator describes 225 songs developed for the game universe. The full album-listening room is a planned page, not a broken link on this site.

PLANNED COOPERATIVE ONLINE EXPANSION

REALM PHILADELPHIA:
OPEN CITY.

Your city. Your skills. Your adventure. Start with a garden and community work board in North Philly, earn your first skills, and build a future wherever you choose in Philadelphia. Open City is planned multiplayer, not part of the currently downloadable Windows demo.

Character growth & skill tracksFarms, shops & propertiesJobs & helpersCooperative NPC missionsMythic territoriesOnline expansion · In development

START WITH A GARDEN

Learn your neighborhood, protect a crop, accept a community job and choose how to grow.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Restaurant owner? Robotics inventor? Barber? Builder? Musician? Gardener? Find work that fits the character you want to become.

KEEP THE CITY ALIVE

Water mains, winter pipes, potholes, power, transit, deliveries and community needs turn hidden city jobs into missions.

OPEN CITY CAREER & COOPERATIVE MODES

01OPEN CITY: YOUR PHILADELPHIA＋

Start in North Philly with a garden and community board. Choose your neighborhood later; earn XP, equipment, armor, costumes, abilities and property opportunities.

Partner fit: Cross-industry city / development partnerships
02CONSTRUCTION CREW＋

Read plans, measure framing, simulate safe trade skills, improve properties and maintain buildings as neighborhoods expand.

Partner fit: Builders · contractors · tool suppliers · trade schools
03STREET CLEANUP CREW＋

Help restore public spaces; convert verified cleanup service into educational achievements and possible arcade rewards under a future partner program.

Partner fit: Sanitation · neighborhood programs · nonprofits
04BUILD YOUR OWN LAB＋

Set up a robotics, technology or maker laboratory and discover design, coding, manufacturing and engineering roles.

Partner fit: Robotics · universities · STEM programs
05PLAYER BUSINESSES / LEARN TO EARN＋

Choose a salon, restaurant, farm, shop, tech operation or other vocation; manage staff, service, inventory, budgets and deliveries.

Partner fit: Local businesses · entrepreneurship programs
06FARMS & FOOD SUPPLY＋

Grow produce, manage irrigation, harvest, process, bottle, transport and supply community kitchens.

Partner fit: Farms · markets · food distribution

CITY SERVICES, CULTURE & MYTHIC REALMS

01FIRE & RESCUE: HOT OFF THE GRILL＋

Complete fictional cooperative emergency scenarios with the Pineapple Squad, safe routes and team rescue roles.

Partner fit: Fire safety · emergency service programs
02COMMUNITY DISCOVERY & READING NODES＋

Visit libraries, museums and nonprofit event hubs for reading, culture, communication, networking and optional JW Comics character discoveries.

Partner fit: Reading Captains · museums · nonprofits
03FOLD-UP CHAIR CREW＋

A venue needs an event by showtime—but half the crew is missing. Organize setup, seating, stage equipment, staff tasks and the launch.

Partner fit: Event venues · rentals · promoters
04CITY VISION BUILDER＋

After Harvest of Victory, reveal city-system layers and unfinished side quests. Utilities, potholes, cold-weather plumbing, deliveries and jobs become missions.

Partner fit: Utilities · civic education · infrastructure
05MYTHIC REALM EXPEDITIONS＋

Unlock the Corn Syrup Swamps, Cotton Candy Mountains, Broccoli Gardens and other realms for cooperative faction missions.

Partner fit: World building · environment art
06DESTINATION EXPEDITIONS＋

Future sponsor-supported field trips beyond Philadelphia: museums, aquariums and cultural institutions become researched destinations and DLC.

Partner fit: Tourism · destinations · museums

AFTER THE WAR: CITY VISION BUILDER

Harvest of Victory unlocks the full City Vision perspective in Story Mode. Outstanding quests, city infrastructure, business opportunities, helpers and skill paths become easier to discover. Online begins with simple guidance and can expand those city abilities as players progress.

The 48 Gods of Hope remains a separate optional progression path—not a reward locked behind completing all indexed missions.

INDUSTRY PARTNERS · REAL ECONOMIC OPPORTUNITIES

YOUR BUSINESS.
A PLAYABLE MISSION.

A sponsor doesn't just buy an advertisement. A well-scoped partnership helps fund reusable game systems: kitchens, factories, laboratories, job skills, missions, locations, art and cooperative challenges. A child can learn what your industry does by playing through a meaningful fictional task.

FARMS & FOOD SYSTEMS

ARTISTS & VENUES

DESTINATION DLC

GAME CATALOG · COOPERATIVE AGAINST PROCESS CHAOS

THE FOOD WAR IS ONLY THE BEGINNING.

Big battles, quick mini-games, magical kitchens, tactical rescues and Little Legends Fun Zones. Each title opens to reveal its gameplay and the industry that could help bring it to life. These are development concepts unless marked as part of the existing Windows demo.

THE HEADLINERS

01Master the Art of the Brew＋

The island command becomes a living food-and-recipe game. Gather ingredients, master timing, prepare meals, smoothies and fantasy brews, run food trucks, and make deliveries.

Partner fit: Restaurants · farms · grocers · culinary schools
02The Great Food Fight: Battle Mode＋

Switch among Fruit Force and Veggie Force heroes during massive fights against Process Chaos, the Sugar Mafia, mutant fruit armies and other NPC enemies.

Partner fit: Game studios · character artists · action developers
03Mini Food Fights＋

Short food battles: the enemies throw junk food, your team clears the mess and turns it into a comeback. Food waste becomes compost, then Butter Beans, then the Butter Bean Effect Gatling Gun.

Partner fit: Food education · composting · environmental organizations
04Protect the Garden＋

Grow and defend your starter garden. Later, enter the mythic Broccoli Gardens where the Veggie Force protects sprouts against Sugar Mafia attacks.

Partner fit: Garden centers · farms · irrigation · community gardens
05Search & Rescue: Realm Signals＋

Baby potato spuds and other allies have been taken. Scout, follow clues, outsmart traps and escort them home; Root Recall helps characters remember their origins.

Partner fit: Rescue educators · public-service partners · community organizations
06Sugar Mafia Factory Raids＋

Tactical cooperative raids on three dangerous operations: Sugar Mafia plants, genetically altered fruit laboratories and Mystery Meat factories. Investigate, rescue, shut down hazards and restore the site.

Partner fit: Food processing · science labs · safety education
07Gladiator Mode＋

Survive arena-based NPC waves, protect teammates, adapt hero powers and earn upgrades. Players fight Process Chaos together, not one another.

Partner fit: Entertainment centers · combat and animation developers
08Iron Chef of the Galaxy＋

Family cooking goes cosmic with Autumnn’s Best Spaghetti in the Galaxy, Dr. Elsewhere, dimensional disruptions and a kitchen where cooking rules still matter.

Partner fit: Restaurants · chefs · culinary schools
09Little Legends Fun Zones＋

Bowling alleys, laser-tag arenas, inflatables, arcades and sponsored family attractions become destinations where mini-games, earned points and local experiences connect.

Partner fit: Family fun centers · bowling · laser tag · venues
10Track Man＋

Deorum drives a tractor through a lively field maze, avoids pests and picks up fruit salads, milkshakes and surprise family power-ups.

Partner fit: Agriculture · tractors · farm education

ARCADE, MYSTERY & MINI-GAMES

01Cotton Crunch Chaos Run＋

Survive the spectacular—but corrupted—Bahamas carnival, with the Ring Toss of Temptation, Mirror Maze of False Shine, Sugar Slide Rush and a Cotton Crunch boss encounter.

Partner fit: Carnivals · arcade owners · creative studios
02Pombomb Sky Defense＋

Fire pomegranate seed bursts into the sugar-cloud invasion, protecting the field from candy drones and flying enemies.

Partner fit: Arcades · technical game design
03Why Is the Apple Blinking?＋

Investigate a strange blinking fruit, avoid scanners and uncover the secrets of the mutant laboratory.

Partner fit: STEM labs · research education
04Mystery Meat Kitchen Escape＋

Race through a chaotic production kitchen, dodge grease traps, expose fake flavor machinery and discover what the factory is hiding.

Partner fit: Food safety · kitchen equipment
05Fruit Kabob Frenzy＋

Slide across the screen, catch good fruit on the kabob stick, avoid junk food and fill customer orders.

Partner fit: Markets · produce retailers · food trucks
06Ketchup to Colonel Mustard＋

Race to collect real evidence before overconfident Colonel Mustard makes a five-second assumption and gets the answer wrong.

Partner fit: Libraries · educators · critical thinking
07The Blame Game＋

A playful mystery inspired by the eight-arrow embroidery design: everybody points fingers, but progress comes from responsibility.

Partner fit: Family-learning partners · youth programs
08Memory Mini-Games＋

Quick card-matching and character-memory challenges tucked inside the Little Legends Fun Zones.

Partner fit: Learning centers · arcade venues
09Star Selector: From Studio to Stage＋

A working name for Deorum’s performing-artist journey: create music, rehearse, book venues, promote events and take the stage.

Partner fit: Recording studios · artists · performance venues
10JW Comics Multiverse Clash＋

An optional, separate character-fighting arcade machine with collectible hero introductions and unlocks discovered through stories and reading nodes.

Partner fit: Comic shops · libraries · arcade operators

TEAMWORK RULE

Great Food Fight battles, rescue missions, factory raids and Gladiator Mode are cooperative fights against NPC enemies. There is no player-versus-player combat in the planned children’s cooperative world.

Priority development includes hero switching, cooperative NPC combat, networking, account and cloud progress, mission state, matchmaking, inventory, city systems, property and business simulation, moderation, child safety, QA, and releases. Sponsorships fund scoped, reusable gameplay—not only ad placement.

ACOTTON CRUNCH'S CARNIVAL＋

Welcome to Bahamas Carnival; Ring Toss of Temptation; Mirror Maze of False Shine; Sugar Slide Rush; Master the Art of the Brew; Cotton Cloud Pop Defense; Cotton Crunch Boss Fight; Council of Mother Nature; Mission to Farmer Brown.

BSTAR SELECTOR • SHOWTIME & EVENT PRODUCTION＋

Create songs, record with musicians, rehearse, book venues, promote shows and perform across Philadelphia. Build a music career through the artistic and business sides of live entertainment.

CTHE LITTLE LEGENDS REWARD SYSTEM＋

Fair high scores, school achievements, verified community cleanup, prizes and arcade points are proposed systems. Future real-world rewards require partner agreements and child-safe verification without sharing grades publicly.

DJW COMICS MULTIVERSE CLASH＋

The Space DJ Arcade Portal introduces Space DJ; Memoryforge is a separate JW Comics character, not merely a memory-matching mechanic. Collectible character discoveries at approved library and community nodes unlock hero lore and distinct fighting-game experiences.

EFACTION / MYTHIC BATTLE MAPS＋

Fruit Force teamwork in the Corn Syrup Swamps; Veggie Force defending Broccoli Gardens; Dragon Fruit warriors on the Cotton Candy Mountains; Pineapple Squad rescue and sky operations. Character switching and special abilities change the tactical route.
